name: glossy_spirals
description: glossy blades or tubes lit like satin sweeping along a spiral's arms over a lit relief of the smooth count, the set's filigree and small spiral copies all round; one stack in each kept map
reuses: light (slope relief on the smooth count, molten_flow)
notes: violet_star_arms: Added: nothing new to the engine; the map violet_star_arms (blue black, indigo, violet to periwinkle and a dusty pink at the set, so the lace reads pink as the reference's does), rank gamma 1.6 for its 0.46 black share, blades at the periwinkle.

violet_star_arms: Lessons: item 036 brought six references whose look is glossy lit tubes or blades sweeping along a spiral's arms with the set's filigree all round them (dessert-union, evening-radiance, eventide, exile, fools-paradise, deadly-nightshade, all -25.jpg), and they went in as **one stack in six palettes**: molten_flow's glossy relief (a light on the smooth count at one band, no ring), a strip trap's blades lit edge to edge as cylinders (shaded_blades), and falloff glows on `de` laid last. **One strip, not a lattice**: a lattice of strips is a target every orbit hits, so its blades fan over the whole frame as shards and arcs; one strip (radius 0.3 through 0.5, no `spacing`) is missed by most orbits, and its entries string along the arms as a staircase of petals. **Bound both ends and fade towards the set**: unbounded at 0.15 of the frame the blades read as a gloss sheet that swallows the lace, leaving only its hair; at `largest` 0.08 and `smallest` 0.015, masked by the inverted smooth count to power 3, they sit in the far field between the spiral copies and the filigree stays on top. A magnified view (zoom 0.3) of the same count as rimmed sheets gives a ghost of bigger arms beneath, the references' blurred copies, but a light cannot read a view, so the ghost is never lit (the `ghost` formulation). Seats are a `--spiral` scout (seed 36) over final139_general and final140_general2000; dense lace seats read the blades as hatching and were dropped, and the phoenix-classic spirals, whose big arms are a clear staircase, read best. Round one is drawn at --draft (about 1 s a frame at six threads).

knobs.label: Light direction
knobs.what: where the light comes from, in degrees round the frame (135 is the upper left)

knobs.name: blade_size
knobs.label: Blade size
knobs.what: how long the glossy blades along the spiral arms may grow

knobs.name: shadow
knobs.label: Background shadow
knobs.what: how deeply the open background between the arms falls into shadow

knobs.name: relief
knobs.label: Relief depth
knobs.what: how deeply the background is sculpted by the light

knobs.name: lace_glow
knobs.label: Lace glow
knobs.what: the soft light along the fine lace at the set's edge
